description.value: The Fairmont Chateau Whistler is a flagship luxury mountain resort hotel positioned at the base of Whistler-Blackcomb in the heart of Whistler Village, making it one of the most prominent accommodation options on the Sea-to-Sky corridor. The property includes multiple restaurants, bars, a spa, fitness facilities, pools, and golf, as well as ski access, catering to guests seeking full-service resort amenities. Touring cyclists will find themselves steps from Whistler Village's extensive trail network and services.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a real, actively operating luxury hotel (the Fairmont Chateau Whistler) in Whistler, BC, with on-site dining venues (restaurants, bars, and breakfast) listed under the Dine section. OSM confirms Wi-Fi via internet_access=wlan. No cycling-specific amenities (bike storage, tools, wash area, etc.) are mentioned in either the website content or OSM tags; the website content is dominated by global Fairmont navigation menus with limited Whistler-specific detail.
concerns: Website content retrieved is dominated by global Fairmont navigation menus; the Whistler-specific subpage content is thin, limiting confirmation of amenity details, phone number, and street address.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible luxury hotel in Whistler, BC; clearly operating and relevant to touring cyclists needing accommodation on the Sea-to-Sky corridor.

Nearby evening food.detail: Hotel has on-site restaurants and bars per website Dine section ('Restaurants, Bars, Breakfast'); Whistler Village location also provides many additional options
